items.title: A ring is Jacobson exactly when its spectrum is a Jacobson topological space
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file algebra.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma states that a ring is Jacobson exactly when its spectrum is a Jacobson topological space (statement lines 6908-6913). The proof does not quote the translation: it unwinds the topological condition into the existence of a maximal ideal containing a given ideal and not meeting a given open set, uses the ring-theoretic Jacobson property to produce it, and then verifies the converse by comparing the closed subsets through the bijection with radical ideals (proof lines 6915-6942). Keeping track of which radical ideals the open and closed pieces cut out is what makes the two conditions line up. H2.
